english: I didn't want to open the door with sticky fingers, so I kicked the door with my foot, but it stuck.
text: 中文说“用脚踢门”容易逐字想到 use foot to kick，其实英语直接说 kicked the door with my foot 更自然，用 with 引出做动作的工具或身体部位。以后表达“用什么做某事”，优先考虑 with，不必生硬加 use。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
